about_built: TikSave AI ko banaya hai Asad Bukhari × Muse AI ne — creators ke liye ek tez, saaf aur imandar toolkit.
ai_disclaimer: AI se taiyaar karda tajziya — istemaal se pehle jaaiza lein.
ai_off: AI features filhaal دستیاب nahi hain.
ai_unavailable_hint: Inhein on karne ke liye OPENAI_API_KEY ya GEMINI_API_KEY set karein.
analyze_caption: Dastiyaab maloomat dekhne ke liye public TikTok video ka link dein.
analyzing: TikTok se raabta ho raha hai…
backend_wait: API server start ho raha hai…
contact_sub: Sawal, feedback ya takedown request — rabta karo:
creator: Creator
faq1a: Ji haan — har core tool free hai. AI features ke liye apni OpenAI ya Gemini API key chahiye.
faq2a: Nahi. TikSave AI sirf public videos ke saath kaam karta hai aur login, DRM ya watermark bypass nahi karta.
faq2q: Kya private ya DRM-protected videos download ho sakti hain?
faq3a: Original creators. Sirf wohi content download karo jiska tumhe haq ho ya ijazat ho, aur creators ko credit do.
faq3q: Download ki hui videos ka malik kaun hai?
faq4a: Nahi. Files temporary storage mein process hoti hain aur foran delete ho jati hain.
faq4q: Kya tum meri videos store karte ho?
feat1d: Public TikTok videos Best, 1080p, 720p ya 480p quality mein save karo.
feat2d: Remix, ringtone aur edits ke liye saaf audio nikalo.
feat3d: Apni uploads ko trim, crop, resize, compress, convert, GIF aur mute karo.
feat4d: English, Urdu aur Roman Urdu mein viral-ready captions.
feat5d: Speech-to-text transcripts aur downloadable .srt subtitle files.
feat6d: Smart hashtag sets aur offline keyword helper — bina API key ke.
footer_note: FastAPI, Streamlit, yt-dlp, FFmpeg aur Whisper ke saath banaya gaya.
hero_sub: Public TikTok videos download karo, Clean Export studio mein polish karo, aur AI captions, hashtags aur transcripts se apni posts ko boost do.
hero_title: Apne TikTok Content ko Save, Edit aur Grow Karo
how_s1d: Koi bhi public TikTok video ka URL upar wale box mein dalo.
how_s2d: Metadata dekho, phir apni pasand ki quality mein video, MP3 audio ya thumbnail save karo.
how_s3d: Clean Export mein trim, compress, GIF banao, phir AI se captions likho.
inspector_sub: Apni upload ki duration, resolution, codec aur audio tracks dekho.
kw_input: Apna caption ya transcript paste karo
kw_note: Offline helper: aam alfaaz nikaal kar frequent words. Ye AI-generated nahi hai.
kw_sub: AI key nahi? Koi baat nahi — ye built-in helper tumhare text se keywords aur hashtags suggest karta hai.
legal_notice: Ye tool sirf us media ke liye hai jis ke aap maalik hain, jise download/use karne ki aap ko ijaazat hai, ya jo qanooni tor par download ke liye دستیاب hai. Mutalliqah qawaneen, platform ki sharaait aur copyright ki pabandi ke saarif khud zimmedar hain.
no_media: Download ke liye pehle video analyze karein.
process_caption: Trim, crop, resize, compress, convert karne ya audio, thumbnail aur subtitles nikaalne ke liye apni video upload karein.
title: Unwaan
transcribing: Audio nikaali ja rahi hai aur transcription ho rahi hai…
transcript_hint: Analyze ki hui video transcribe karein ya apna transcript neeche dein.
